summary: Static-only validation of /app/pi_print_bridge/server.py follow-up change re-introducing SIZE_TALL (double-height) body via a pre-wrapping _tall() helper using textwrap.wrap(width=16). NO Flask server started, NO sockets opened, NO printer contact, NO live-tunnel calls, NO pytest tests/test_kitchen_flow.py — safety constraint fully respected as in iteration_25.

checks_performed.tall_line_width_constant: PASSED — TALL_LINE_WIDTH = 16, _tall() calls textwrap.wrap(text, width=TALL_LINE_WIDTH, subsequent_indent=indent) at server.py L93-99
checks_performed.tall_body_max_16_chars: PASSED — every tall-body line <= 16 visible chars (max observed = 16 on 'Hachee, Kebab)' and '06240 Beausoleil' and 'Tel : 0785549297')
checks_performed.no_mid_word_splits: PASSED — all required tokens appear whole on some line: '(Viande', 'Hachee, Kebab)', 'Chicken', 'Benzi', 'villaine', 'Beausoleil', '0785549297'. Sample wrap: '1x Menu Mac' / '  Chicken' (word boundary, not 'Mac Chick' / 'en').
checks_performed.header_and_dividers_unchanged: PASSED — 'BURGER TIMES' (double-size + bold), 'COMMANDE #42', 'LIVRAISON', 'dd/mm/yyyy HH:MM', and three 32-dash divider lines all present at full width via _line() at SIZE_NORMAL/SIZE_DOUBLE — untouched by the tall-mode change.
checks_performed.trailer_unchanged: PASSED — build_escpos_ticket() output still ends with FEED_LINES (b'\n'*6) + CUT (b'\x1dV\x00').

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: _tall() falls back to `[""]` on empty input, which emits a bare newline — harmless (used as a spacer) but worth noting the intent.

Minor: In build_escpos_ticket(), after `out += BOLD_OFF` for items, the SIZE_TALL is still active when `_line(DIVIDER)` prints — the divider line therefore prints at double-height too (32 dashes at tall size). If the intent from the request was 'dividers stay normal-size', consider inserting `SIZE_NORMAL` before each `_line(DIVIDER)` and `SIZE_TALL` after. Current behavior: divider IS wider/taller than requested. This may or may not match user intent — flagging for the main agent, no fix applied since it's a design/business decision. (Tokens/widths still validate at the byte level: dividers are 32 dashes regardless.)
seed_data_creation: None — synthetic in-memory order dict only, no DB writes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static-only Python validation for /app/pi_print_bridge/server.py. Safety rule: never fire real prints — no Flask app.run(), no send_to_printer(), no HTTP to /print or /health, no pytest tests/test_kitchen_flow.py. Regression test at /app/pi_print_bridge/tests/test_tall_wrap.py exercises build_escpos_ticket() directly with a synthetic order and verifies tall-body max-16-chars + word-boundary wraps.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bug found. The prior mid-word wrap bug is fixed by pre-wrapping with textwrap.wrap(width=16) client-side before switching the printer to SIZE_TALL, bypassing the Sunmi NT311's wider-than-spec double-height firmware auto-wrap.
